label: Marketing channel mix
description: Propose which owned/paid/earned channels to use for a brief (and which repertoire connectors to attach next)
propose_guide: Use after marketing/campaign-brief (or vertical skills marketing/local-store / marketing/hiring-campaign) when NL asks which channels to use. Map goal+audience to a small channel mix and name concrete repertoire connectors when available: linkedin/publish (B2B Page), instagram/publish (visual Feed), twitter/publish / facebook/publish, mailchimp/campaign or klaviyo/campaign (email), wordpress/post or webflow/cms-publish (SEO/CMS), hubspot/contact-upsert or hubspot/crm-note (CRM), google/analytics-report (measure). Prefer 2–4 channels. Do not invoke write-external connectors in this skill — only recommend next steps for Propose. Call out when a channel needs human approval.
